info.title: Postgres.Cli
info.description: A small command line tool for routine PostgreSQL work: applying versioned SQL scripts and reporting what has been applied.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Tools for working with PostgreSQL databases.

commands.name: upgrade
commands.description: Apply every script that has not been applied yet.

options.name: --connection
options.description: Connection string for the database to work on.

options.name: --path
options.description: Folder containing the .sql files this command works on, in file name order.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: List what would be applied, and apply nothing. [default: False]

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show which scripts have been applied and which are waiting.

options.name: --connection
options.description: Connection string for the database to work on.

options.name: --path
options.description: Folder containing the .sql files this command works on, in file name order.
